tweets.text: The origins of DHS can be traced to November 25, 2002, when the Homeland Security Act and Maritime Security Act were signed, marking the largest reorganization of the federal government since the National Security Act of 1947. #DHSat20

tweets.text: DHS was created in the wake of the 9/11 attacks to safeguard the U.S. against terrorism. Today, homeland security is national security – and our mission to ensure a safer, more secure, and more resilient America remains the same. #DHSat20

"The Department of Homeland Security is more than ever fit for purpose [...] to deal with these complex and ever-evolving array of threats."

"So, with these ever-evolving threats, we need to continue together to build a better national security system because at the end of the day, homeland security inherently is national security."

"We can only do this with partnerships [...] interagency, with state, local, tribal, territorial, campus level law enforcement, with the private sector, and literally with all of you."
